newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - Aug 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - Aug 4.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Failure of fiscal reform weakens German Chancellor Helmut Kohl
-- Franch has difficulty getting semi-conductor firms to set up business in the country. Corporate leaders blame taxes and plan to propose changes to government for inclusion in 1998 budget.
-- Vereinsbank and Hypo-Bank embark on first stage of merger
